notes.title: ATLYSS 82025.a2 Released
notes.content:
ATLYSS Version 82025.a2 Released.
Verify integrity of game cache if the update does not occur.


Re-added steam profile inspection, a small steam logo icon will appear on who tab cells. Clicking it will take you to the steam profile of the player.
The host player now properly retrieves their steam ID on netplay sessions, allowing players to view their steam profile in the who tab.
Added new prediction buffers for projectile collision, improving the issue where projectiles incorrectly collide or not with npcs or players via clientside.
Added a check if the player is attacking or air attacking, preventing from un-equipping or equipping gear.
Removing skills from the action bar by right clicking now only works when the skills tab menu is open while in a safe zone.
Adjusted hitbox source cache, improving how hitboxes (specifically projectile and skill hitboxes) retrieve data from players or npcs when spawned into the game.
Taunt is no longer a support skill, and is now an action skill. This will no longer apply incorrectly in pvp sessions.
The shadow projection object and healthbars / castbars above players heads will no longer appear when they are invisible.
Dead players will appear in their dead animation when loaded into a lobby, rather than them standing still with their eyes closed.

notes.title: ATLYSS 82025.a1 Released
notes.content:
ATLYSS Version 82025.a1 Released.
Verify integrity of game cache if the update does not occur.

--Content--

Added Orange, Lime, White, Pink, and Brown dyes.
Added a setting to disable / hide the icons above certain NPC's heads. (This may be turned on by default in case if you wanted to have them appear still).
Added an Enok repeatable kill quest for lv20-25 Crescent Grove.
Added the Colossus Tone to Rikko's badge store.
All races now share some eye sprites for customization.
Added new hairstyles for the Poon race.


--Fixes / Adjustments--

Fixed not being able to hotkey sit while the UI is toggled off.
Fixed the white / bright texture bug on players when connecting to a lobby.
Fixed being able to purchase a larger quantity of a buyback item if there is a limited / smaller quantity to it on the shop menu.
Fixed shop menu cells not displaying a limited quantity counter for buyback items.
Fixed the top left map title card font being too large.
Fixed the trigger message being stuck on the screen when toggling the Hide UI setting.
Fixed font sizes for the Dungeon Key and PVP arena counters.
Fixed the shadow projection object (the shadow circle below players) being shown if they are invisible.
Lowered the volume of the Haste condition buff.
Updated EXP font on the bottom bar, making it more readable.
Updated the cells in the Who Menu Tab, showing more information of the players such as their class.
Adjusted font size for the character names on the character selection screen.
Emoting while fishing now cancels the fishing process, fixing any animation bug / issue pertaining to that.
Added a serverside buffer check if the player is in an empty state for combat, disabling any lingering hitboxes.
Removed the "Steamworks" panel on the Who Menu tab. Global names are now displayed on the list cells if there is a @globalname available.
Skill icons on the action bar now grey out if the Chatbox or the Tab Menu is open, and the Skill tab menu is not selected.
The party cells now correctly display the subclass icons of players.
Player nametags display their levels again.

Brightened the starting clothes for Byrdles to better represent dyes, such as the black dye.
Fixed dedicated vendor prices not working correctly. Example, Frankie selling a cape for 50 crowns, but ended up selling for 12 crowns instead.
Increased the ground pound effect size for the Barknaughts.
Added a stat re-adjustment for the King Golem enemies (Colossus and Valdur) for when they wake up, where it will attempt to scale the health on them appropriately.

notes.title: ATLYSS Version 72025.a4 Released
notes.content:
ATLYSS 72025.a4 Released

A new patch for ATLYSS is released. Verify integrity of game cache if the update does not occur.


Skill limitation for Action and Support skills are removed. You are free to apply any skill of any type on any slot.
Removed the "Up and Beyond" quest from Angela, moving it to Craig in the Wall of the Stars as an optional quest. It provides a hat as a reward.
Added checkpoints to the Trial of the Stars.
Revised the Mystic primary skill cooldowns, scaling, and cast times.
Readjusted the Magic Power scaling to be the same as Dex Power scaling.
Fixed Gahool from constantly casting Imbue while fighting.
Reverted (For now) Lethal Strike to be a hold and release skill instead of a passive. It will be reworked as a passive in later versions.
Increased the condition duration of Taunt, increased the defense decrease of Taunt, and decreased the cooldown time of Taunt.
Increased experience gain bonus when killing modified enemies (example: Killer Geist, Magical Wizboar, etc).
Slightly decreased health scaling on enemies with party count.
Lowered the amount of orb projectiles Valdur spawns.
King Golems (Colossus and Valdur) should have their attack animations properly interrupted when parried or stunned.
Decreased projectile / distance attacking spam for Barknaughts and Deathknights.

Fixed the quest text incorrectly explaining where to go to the Crescent Keep in the "Keep Within" quest.
Fixed Angela not providing the "Sprialing In the Grove" quest.
Fixed the chatbox not properly muting the channels when muted. The zone chat channel will return in a later version.
The chatbubble returns, while players type.
Fixed the (AFK) and [HOST] tag not displaying properly on players.

notes.title: ATLYSS Progress Update - 7/8/2025
notes.content:
Hello everyone, thank you so much for all of your feedback for ATLYSS. I have been taking as much time as I can to read all the feedback provided for the new update that released yesterday. A lot of the game has changed, and I'm aware and learning what outcome is for taking as long as I have on this update.

There will be a new patch for the game, addressing some of the common issues regarding the skill system, mostly pertaining to the Mystic class balancing.



What to expect for this upcoming patch:

Revised Mystic skill cool downs and cast times, alongside skill power adjustments.

For the time being, Lethal Strike will be reverted back to a charge and release skill as it was more stable than the dash modifier. I will find a new solution later on for making the Fighter's dash upgrade work in conjunction with the Mystic and Bandit dash passives.

Adjusted defense dampening on enemies, and slightly lowered health scaling for enemies for parties.

Removal of the Angela quest for Trial of the Stars, replacing it with a different NPC at the Wall of the Stars. The latter was the original plan, but I did not have enough time. To be clear, the Trial of the Stars is not required, despite appearing as an Angela attunement quest.

Reverting the 6 action slot and 4 support slot limitation from the skill actionbars.



There may be more adjustments and additions to this upcoming patch. If so, more information will be provided when the patch releases.



Thank you so much again for your support and your feedback!

notes.title: ATLYSS Version 72025.a3 Released
notes.content:
Version 72025.a3
A new version of Atlyss has been released. 


Refactored Game Mechanics
Added Fishing
Level Cap increased to 40
Subclasses are available from the 20-25 Hard Grove badge vendor as tomes for Paladin, Bishop, and Magus. All these subclasses that can be obtained are a work in progress.
Lexicon is removed, and will be reworked into the dialog system in a later version.
More Quests added
6 Slot Novice Skill limit removed, the skillbook is now endless.
The three guardian trainer npcs now provide additional novice skills to the player.
Lvl 20-25 hard mode Crescent Grove added, loot table will be improved in later versions, alongside enemy drops. There are new gear sets for all three primary classes.
Overworld for the Outer Sanctum zone re-done, still a work in progress.
More customization options added for Changs and Byrdles
Netplay optimization reworked, should be less laggy for hosts
All three primary classes have their skillbooks filled.
Skill system reworked, removed ranks from skills and gave them skill point costs instead, scaling them to their pertaining attributes.
A new quest giver added nearby the Sanctum Catacombs, giving all of Angela's and Enok's repeatable catacombs quests to her instead.
Lobby Realm system added for PvE, PvP, Social, and RP lobbies.
Reworked the Waypoint UI system, still a work in progress.
Stats given on gear have been reworked.
More various fixes, adjustments, and other things too far to list.


Moving forward, I will be releasing progress updates and game updates more frequently at the best of my ability. Thank you so much again for your patience!

notes.title: Atlyss Update Coming 7/7/2025!
notes.content:
A new update for the live branch of Atlyss will be releasing on July 7th, 2025. To view any information regarding the update, check out the previous update logs.



Guaranteed things to expect for this update:

Hard Mode Crescent Grove (20-25).

New loot / gear to collect.

New enemies to fight.

Updated Skill System / new skills to collect.

Endless General Skillbook, removing the 6 slot limit.

Fishing.

New quests.

15 pages of character slots, up to 105 slots.

New realm system for multiplayer lobbies (PvE, PvP, Social, RP).

More customization options for several races.

Redone overworld for outer sanctum zone.

Filled skillbooks for all primary classes.

Bishop and Magus for Mystic subclasses will be available at level 28, however UNFINISHED. Bishop will be the more complete subclass. Other subclasses will not be obtainable. A debug / placeholder NPC will provide tomes for those two subclasses.

More optimized netplay experience, less lag overall for hosting.

Refactored enchants for equipment. All enchants will be reset for previous characters.

Refactored chatbox, allowing you to make custom chatrooms.

UNFINISHED gamepad integration, gameplay works for it, however various menus with gamepad support is not finalized.

Many core gameplay enhancements / refactorings

Badge merchants for dungeons are added, allowing you to purchase some items dropped from the dungeon bosses if RNG is against you.

Level cap set to 40.

And.... more?

notes.title: Atlyss Progress Update - 6/1/2025
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

First and foremost, thank you for your support for the game and ultimately your patience. It's understandable that there is a lot of tension and I'm well aware of it all. Just to reiterate, there was the lack of transparency and communication that I provided here, and I'm looking to fix that and let everyone know that I am still hard at work on this game. I am eager to keep learning on how to manage this sort of thing so I will do the best I can to maintain things and be as clear as I can.

A lot of the game as it stands on the live / retail version was very unfinished and in prototype condition, but since then I have completely revamped and revitalized a lot of the systems, ultimately making it much easier for me to develop with.

New Skill System
One of the major hurdles that I've had while developing this game was creating skills. Before, skills had a rank system. Each rank used different skill logic objects and parameters, making it a bit of a pain to manage. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830931/79789ae3b33f95b2260ab8efe403d15a5edb77d6.gif
Instead, I have gotten rid of the rank system for skills and made them cost a certain amount of skill points. This means there's no level requirement on them either, so you can purchase skills with your points as long as they are available in your skillbook.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830931/a7f01ef09345c7e06861f392b810a37396254d4e.png
To compensate for the removal of the ranks, the skills will scale with their stat attribute. For example Prism being a mind skill, will scale its absorption based on your magic power stat. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830931/7a8f58c0ec22bc573f58d4baaa2ce80fa1489be7.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830931/b59baceb46a412e08723d7969eaef21b1e86eed7.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830931/80b795c1d01b714308660095e51ae2d846da63f0.png
All the three primary classes have their skillbooks filled.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830931/a5bc10fbdb7503bee955110f918739bdfe0b5693.gif
In this new Skill System, you will have two actionbars to work with for your alt and primary weapon swaps. Both bars will have four slots for "Action Skills", and two slots for "Support Skills". I chose to do this for balancing and to still provide a sense of limitation for skill loadout building.

New Overworld
The workflow I had while building the old overworld wasn't particularly working well for me. Instead I have opted to use a terrain system for the overworld maps, making things look more natural.

I did experiment with the idea of making one large map containing all of the old segments of the outer sanctum zone, but it ended up being too big of a scope to work with. I have made the choice to keep things segmented, but the new terrain zones make the exploration experience feel more open and free. It's also extremely fast to revise these old maps with the terrain.

New Outer Sanctum
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830931/86426f5227731db9aec8f7d6e0da1aa503eed4a8.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830931/8557bc795d5383f745be40c01e486368ea43737c.png

New Effold Terrace
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830931/99cabb65ea2cddb9ee8b2e31618507bc5f5dec36.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830931/bf040b6b73cae6fd75518c6eb44ac7b749367241.png

Weather in the Overworld Maps
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830931/8cfb9bf97302ec1319431853265edb1bf4c61367.gif

New Character Selection / Creation Screen
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830931/40e43324243e2eb7de8a9512fcfd9cc95fa2ea4d.gif
The character selection / creation screen has a new environment and look to it. All of the player models have been refined to look more rounder / softer and less jagged.

Lowest / Thin Proportion example
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830931/5308d8d19c5f62b594b67a7447781b05c7479127.png

Highest / Fat Proportion example
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830931/29ec541e0e2f6e198c87d0af9357c5b4e2c59f12.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830931/491d9f8727606cc7f130d92a011736d41791c896.gif
Head customization value ranges are increased for some races too.

Netplay Optimization
One of the biggest issues in Atlyss is the netplay performance. Atlyss is primarily a multiplayer focused game, so this was something I wanted to get to the bottom of. Fortunately, I have found many of the causes for the issues with this, and now netplay will be running much smoother for hosts. So far, with up to 6-8 players, the game will still run at over 120fps, at best being near 200fps. There's still a lot of work to do for this, but I am setting aside anymore focus for optimization for netplay until the next public update releases.

Confirmed Level Cap
The confirmed level cap for the game is level 40.

Subclass Development
Development of the subclasses have been going underway, primarily focusing on the Mystic Subclasses. Each of the primary classes will have two subclasses to choose from at level 30.

Fighter - Paladin and Berserker
Mystic - Magus and Bishop
Bandit - Rogue and Engineer

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830931/66b5ef46f92abc3f30e506d96d0621706f9a3ab7.gif
For the next public update, it is most likely that these subclasses will not be finished. The most near complete subclass will be the Bishop.

Moving Forward
I will stay by my word and be committed to continue providing communication and transparency at the best of my ability here each month. Again, I do apologize for taking as long as I am. There is a silver lining to all of this and I'm certain things will turn in a good direction soon.

notes.title: ATLYSS Progress Update - 2/21/2025
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Thank you so much for your support for my project and ultimately your patience. I have been ridiculously busy developing the game, and I'm happy to report that so far things have been going very smoothly. I understand that it has been a struggle for everyone to wait for a long while for this next update, but rest assured there will be quite a lot of additions and changes for the game.

For context, the game is still pretty deep in development. A lot of the code base had to be re-written and re-adjusted so that for future content additions, it won't pile up into an unmanageable mess. One of the biggest additions for the next update is native gamepad support.

Gamepad support was not something I was going to deep focus on for the game until much later down the line, but having a Steamdeck got me motivated to focus on this support. A lot of the games menus / ui were designed with mouse cursor in mind, so I had to spend a lot of time building a separate cursor / navigation system for the gamepad.

So far, the game is about 96% playable with the gamepad natively. There are only but a few more things I have to do for gamepad support to make it fully functional without having to navigate with the mouse cursor.

Some other changes that I've implemented worth noting:

- Level cap increasing to 30+.
- Hard Mode Crescent Grove.
- Entire stat re-adjustment for all existing armors, and attribute stat bonuses.
- New Skill for Mystic and Bandit.
- Moving Execute to Fighter as an exclusive Skill, creating a new Scroll Skill in it's place.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830931/5c37793e16dc1d4bc5c35e1638b8074c82271111.gif
Fishing system.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830931/9e2dc348c38b1a3e8cd8ad21e278d4ea4b72f1bb.gif
Updated the visual aspect of floating combat values, giving them icons and other color variants to tell which element they are.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830931/581920610f57b300fa61eb6809edf1f579b9a27e.gif
Added more visual indicators for modified enemies, making them easier to distinguish. They also provide an actual exp bonus, which was a thing that wasn't working in the current builds.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830931/ae8307be8c408c4de75974c943ea30c94cd5c5f7.png
An entire re-work of the World Portal system, making it easier to navigate where you want to go. Waypoints you activate throughout the world can also be used to teleport to other waypoints, not just the Sanctum one anymore.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830931/61a86d13176b213b335976e47896e53676138b2b.png
Addition of Elemental Resistances / Weaknesses and a re-factoring of the Condition system, adding resistances to certain condition groups such as poisons and curses. Equipment can have resistance modifiers applied to them as well.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830931/a621900f9e31919ef1a09d2e016ceb4f4e1da8da.png
Steam Lobby category "Realms". These are designed to make lobby navigation a bit more streamlined and easier to navigate, so that you can find the experience you're looking for a lot easier with some visual flare.

There's a lot more that I've done for this update, but these are but just a few! 
I will be looking to get this update out as fast as I can, but I do want to be sure that there is plenty to do and that the game provides enough to compensate for the wait.

More info and updates on the progress coming soon.

notes.title: ATLYSS Beta Build 1.6.0a Released
notes.content:
ATLYSS Beta Build 1.6.0a Released
Please verify integrity of game cache or restart the game to update to the newest build.


Steam Cloud integration added. This may take a minute to go into full effect if it's not available yet.
Re-worked saving / backup saving, with a save & quit "are you sure" prompt.
Loading into lobbies no longer does a server -> client remote call for loading quests and inventory since they are clientside parameters anyways.
Equipped items no longer take up inventory slots. Do not be alarmed if your inventory seems emptier.
Performance boost on inventory, refactoring how the item cells function.
The banlist no longer resets when starting a new lobby.
Added a callback for attempting to join friends lobbies that are full, taking you back to the main menu.
Public passworded lobbies will no longer require a password if you're friends with the host on Steam.
Added a 0.005 to 0.285 sec buffer to players when they are attacked, allowing enemies in large groups to attack in a more uniform fashion rather than being sporadic / confusing. Bosses ignore this.
Bells persistent damage now provide"heavy" damage, but explodes after 3 hits for generic bells (cryptcall, wooden bell, etc)
Manaflow now has 5 ranks instead of 3.
Decreased the cast time for Fluxbolt.
Added a trigger message callback when you kill a person in PVP. (ex: "You fragged X.")
Removed the AFK messages in the chatbox when people go AFK or return from being AFK, decreasing traffic on the chatbox.
Added shift click shortcut for equipping.
Vanity has it's own layer for visibility.
Enok given a repeatable lv-1 quest to kill mini geists in the catacombs (optional).
Decreased kill count requirements for several Enok quests.
Refactored weapon damage scaling, it now goes up endlessly at a low % of the respective power stat.
Added an increased defensive effectiveness against weapon damage. Skill damage retains as it was.
Added global nickname system (optional). Regardless what character you play as, the global nickname will appear under your character nametag.
Added skill icons to the skill scroll item data entries for better transparency.
Revised the Sanctum Catacombs platforming segments and enemy arenas.
Increased health boost % on enemies for every nearby player.
Added a distance scaling element to party indicators and pvp emblems that appear over players heads to better see where they are.
Added a "Who Tab Menu" hotkey tutorial in the Outer Sanctum, to teach new players that they can make a party with other players in multiplayer.
Fixed Kubold armor feet disappearing from camera distance / angle.
Fixed Kubold forehead halo not appearing on some horn variants.
Adjusted the condition server sync / client prediction display. (The condition icons above your skill hotbar).
Weapon quickswapping is now near-instant like it once was, additionally fixing many bugs that came along with it at the time.
Devious Signet cooldown reverted back to what it was before.
Summoning the Slime Diva now requires 4 slain Slimeks than 8 in her arena at Effold Terrace.
Siphon Leech no longer bleeds through blocked or missed hits.
Added a minute and second prediction counter for the condition icons that appear above the skill hotbar.
Fixed a bug with jump attacking. Jump attacks now cap current jumps up to the maximum.
Fixed persistent damage outputs on Polearm, Heavy Melee, Katars, and Melee spinning jump attacks.
Increased collider distance of the Heavy Melee jump attack land hitbox.
Pressing escape while in the Host Console menu should properly close it.
Typing in "/help" in the Host Console Menu should now display all the available commands properly.
Support skills such as Restora and Imbue should no longer affect players that aren't in the same party as the caster in PvP arenas.
Movement speed parameter should permanently reset itself while the player is dead. Any other bugs regarding movement speed have not be addressed fully yet.
Added a item drop serverside buffer to prevent clients from dropping items at rapid speeds.
Various bug fixes / exploit fixes.

notes.title: Atlyss Beta Build 1.5.5a Released
notes.content:
Atlyss Beta Build 1.5.5a Released
Please verify integrity of game cache or restart the game to update to the newest build.


Added visual and audio telegraph effects to some enemies (Wisps, Boars, Slimes).
Fixed weapon conditions not working anymore after re-equipping weapons or armor.
Added sorting to Item Storage.
Added auto stacking for shift clicking items into Storage.
Vivian now has a face picture in the dialog box.
Added a new lv-3 chestpiece that drops in the Catacombs.
The Sanctum Catacombs portal no longer opens for players who do not have the quest "Communing Catacombs".
Added a tutorial trigger in the Outer Sanctum regarding auto-pickup by holding the interact key.
Added lobby search filters to the Lobby list finder.
Fixed Skill Point distribution being off for connected clients.
Fixed Skills and Skill Points not being reset when obtaining a class as a client.
Fixed Slime Diva's spike AOE spell not functioning when the host is not on the same map.
Reflect is reworked, it no longer reflects projectiles but now deals a % damage return on parried enemies.

Chests in dungeons no longer have distance checking, all items dropped from chests will retain no matter where the player is located.
Adjusted the item inventory click hold system, should be functional for double-clicking faulty mice without locking you up.

notes.content:
Atlyss Beta Version 1.5.0a Released
Please verify integrity of game cache or restart the game to update to the newest build.


Revised Lobby Entries on the Lobby List Finder. Ping display on lobbies will be coming soon, hopefully.
Lowered Lesser, Greater, and Toxin Wisp base damage.
Wisp curses only lower power stats (attack power, dex power, magic power) instead of all stats.

All enemies that do not have Killer, Magical or Precise modifiers on them no longer crit you.
Fixed abusable quest trigger for "sweep" quests.
Fixed "Rude!" achievement.
Fixed "vista" achievements being given to players while other players reach them in netplay.
Fixed being able to send rich text commands through the chatbox.
Fixed issue where players can have names longer than 18 characters while in a game session.
Fixed issue where players can send extremely long messages in the chatbox.
Fixed a hole in the cave portion of the grove you can fall through.
Ping kick-out threshold is increased from 300 to 500.
Fixed lesser magic def. potions having the incorrect description.
Fixed Enok's grove quest giving the wrong potions (or no potions at all.)
Fixed being stuck in a dialog loop with Enok if you ask him questions.
Increased EXP share % amongst party members.
Golem Cores can now stack up to 99. Drop the cores and pick them back up to reset their stack limit.
Fixed holding item lock issue on the cursor if you die while holding an item in the Tab Menu Inventory.
Transmogging no longer dissipates when you change equipment.
You can now transmog cross-class gear.
Added a "temporary" save file system, hoping to lessen the chance of corruption for hardware crashes / power outages.
Cryo Needle projectiles are now object pooled.
Fixed the loud portals in the Outer Sanctum Gate map.
Adjusted how skill points function.
Adjusted conditions, hopefully fixing the Evasion % boosting and Alacrity skill lockups.
Support projectiles such as Restora and Divine should no longer remove "on hit" conditions like Recovery.
Adjusted ranged weapon aiming system, hopefully fixing the issue where projectiles shoot off in awkward directions pertaining to your cursor position.
Added a "Hide FPS Counter" and a "Hide Ping Counter" option in the Interface Settings Menu.
Lowered the amount of Mekboars that spawn in the entrance of Tuul Valley.

notes.title: Early Access release approaching soon!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, 

thank you so much for your support and your interest in ATLYSS! It's been a long time coming to get to this point, and close to a year later since the initial alpha demo from January, the game is now closing in towards releasing as an Early Access title on the 22nd of this month (November).

I have been doing the best I can to ensure the game has a smooth, stable build on release, but please be aware that stability can be highly unpredictable. If there are any issues that need to be resolved right away on release, I will work as quick as I can to correct and modify what needs to be adjusted.

Unlike the public demo that was released back in August, this release will contain many new features, such as Multiplayer (peer to peer lobbies, both public and private), an Enchanter NPC that can re-roll modifiers and switch up damage scaling for weapons, a new dungeon, increased level cap to 25, more customization options for all the 5 available races, revised/additional skills and skill scrolls, revised stats and attribute stat distribution, updated QOL mechanics, new shop vendors, revised and higher detailed maps, and more.

Thank you again for your patience with me, and sticking around to see the game through as it progresses!
